title: Coding vs Template Strand
text: The DNA coding strand (also called the sense strand) has the same sequence as the mRNA that will be produced, except DNA has thymine while RNA has uracil.

title: T becomes U
text: When converting from the DNA coding strand to mRNA, simply replace every thymine (T) with uracil (U). All other bases remain the same: A stays A, G stays G, C stays C.
